title: Barbed Armor
subtitle: Iron shells of the deep
text: Barbed Armor is crafted from Chitinous Husks and Hematic Iron Scraps. It offers strong protection and comes with a matching Barbed Shield. The material is harvested from Chitinites and Chthonians, iron-shelled insects that merge naturally with blood. The armor's barbed surface punishes attackers on contact.
